meta.name: add-dial-number
meta.description: Add another phone number to an existing Dial channel — a second (or third) public line for the agent, so one NanoClaw install answers SMS and AI voice calls on multiple numbers. Use when Dial is already installed and the operator wants an additional number (e.g. a personal line plus a support line). Requires the Dial channel to already be installed (see /add-dial).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让同一安装接听多个号码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要给现有直线添加额外接听号码
copy.tagline_en: Answer calls on multiple numbers from a single installation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a Dial channel and need to add another number

howto.what: 给已装好的 Dial 通道再加一个电话号码，让同一个 NanoClaw 能同时接多个号码的短信和 AI 语音电话；每个号码是独立线程，agent 用收到消息的那个号码回复。
howto.when: 当 Dial 通道已经安装，操作者想为现有安装追加一个号码（如个人号之外再开客服号）时触发。

say.text: 给 Dial 通道添加号码 +14155550123，接到客服组。
say.note: 会创建该号码的独立线程并绑定到指定客服组。

say.text: 我要再加一个公开号码，谁来都可以发短信。
say.note: 设置该线路为 public 访问模式。

say.text: 把 +8613800138000 加为我个人的私密线路。
say.note: 以 strict 模式添加，仅允许已知用户。

howto.what_en: Adds another phone number to an already-installed Dial channel, so one NanoClaw install serves multiple numbers as separate threaded lines; the agent replies from whichever number a person texted.
howto.when_en: Triggers when Dial is already installed and the operator wants an additional number on the same install (e.g. a support line next to a personal line).

say_en.text: Add +14155550123 to the Dial channel and route it to the support group.
say_en.note: Creates the threaded line for that number and wires it to the chosen group.

say_en.text: I want another number that anyone who knows it can text.
say_en.note: Adds the line with public access.
Adds it in strict mode, only known users can start conversations.
